summary: [Google Analytics 4] rate-limits: Official quota table (Core, standard property): 200,000 tokens/day/property, 40,000 tokens/hour/property, 14,000 tokens/project/property/hour, 10 concurrent requests/property, 10 server errors/project/property/hour (Analytics 360: 2,000,000 / 400,000 / 140,000 / 50 / 50). Tokens charged by query complexity, not row count. 429 = RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: back off and re-read budget. CRITICAL: 500/503 retries count against the server-errors quota: cap retries (unbounded retry locks the property out). Branch on error.status, never error.message.
